panel_findings.statement: In the LixiLan-L trial, the LS mean change in body weight from baseline for SOLIQUA (n=366) was -0.7 ±0.2 kg.
In the LixiLan-L trial, the LS mean change in body weight from baseline for Insulin glargine 100 units/mL (n=365) was +0.7 ±0.2 kg.
In the LixiLan-L trial, the comparison of LS mean change in body weight between SOLIQUA and Insulin glargine had a p-value of p<0.0001.
In the SoliMix trial, body weight change after 26 weeks for SOLIQUA (n=443) was -0.7 ±0.2 kg.
In the SoliMix trial, body weight change after 26 weeks for Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 (n=444) was +1.2 ±0.2 kg.
In the SoliMix trial, the comparison of body weight change between SOLIQUA and Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 had a p-value of p<0.0001.
In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), mean baseline change for SOLIQUA (n=195) was -0.62 ±0.24 kg.
In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), mean baseline change for Basal bolus therapy (n=195) was +0.70 ±0.24 kg.
In the propensity score matching analysis (LixiLan-L and GGD2), the comparison of weight change between SOLIQUA and Basal bolus therapy had a p-value of ρ<0.0001.
